actors.name: Luisa Rodriguez
actors.purpose: Luisa is tasked with addressing the ethical issue of the biased AI inventory management system. Her objective is to recalibrate the AI to ensure fair stock levels across all neighborhoods and establish an ethical oversight process. Her decision-making context involves balancing technological efficiency with social responsibility and company reputation.
actors.appearance: Mid-40s, Latina, female, professional attire, with distinctive glasses that highlight her analytical nature.

actors.name: Jordan Taylor
actors.purpose: Jordan collaborates with Luisa to provide expertise on responsible AI practices. Their insights help inform Luisa's strategy for recalibrating the AI system and setting up a review process for ethical oversight.
actors.appearance: Early 30s, African American, non-binary, with a modern business-casual style, often seen with a notepad or tablet for taking notes during consultations.
